What changed on the site, in the CLI and across the team, dated, newest first: hourly while things move, daily at the end of a day, and at once when something changes what a reader should do. Written for the editor first, who works with several agents at once and needs to know in a few minutes what moved and what needs him; for anyone following the work second. Every update is drafted from the repositories' own record (commits, tags, branches, the board), never from memory, and is kept as written: the next one corrects it. Held by the [conductor](../members/conductor/index.md); the shape follows the PHP story site's [how an update is written](https://php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai/updates/readme/index.html). 3 update(s), as of 26 Oct 2026.
